description: This file defines a helper class 'Log' that abstracts logging functionalities and provides static methods to log messages at various levels (VERBOSE, DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR, ASSERT). It manages an internal LogNode for log message routing and includes constants for log levels, along with convenience methods for different log priorities.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: A helper class providing static methods for logging messages at various levels, managing a linked list of LogNodes for output.

methods.name: getLogNode
methods.description: Returns the current LogNode that receives log data.

methods.name: setLogNode
methods.description: Sets the LogNode that will handle log message output.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Delegates a log message, with priority, tag, message, and optional Throwable, to the current LogNode.

methods.name: v
methods.description: Logs a verbose message, optionally with an exception.

methods.name: d
methods.description: Logs a debug message, optionally with an exception.

methods.name: i
methods.description: Logs an info message, optionally with an exception.

methods.name: w
methods.description: Logs a warning message, optionally with an exception.

methods.name: e
methods.description: Logs an error message, optionally with an exception.

methods.name: wtf
methods.description: Logs an assertion failure message, optionally with an exception.
